'''Deoxys's unnamed world''' is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location found in another [[dimension]]. It was featured in ''[[AG171|Pokémon Ranger - Deoxys' Crisis! Part 1]]'' and ''[[AG172|Part 2]]''.

{{an|Deoxys}} had to hide in the [[Pokémon world]] because of the force created by a meteor. The geomagnetic forces were too powerful for it to handle and caused it intense pain. Deoxys took [[Max]] to another dimension to try to communicate with him about what was causing it pain. In order to do that though, Deoxys also kidnapped {{MTR}} to speak with Max.

To get Max back, {{Ash}}, {{ashfr}}, and [[Solana]] fought Deoxys to get it back to its {{fd|Deoxys|Normal Forme}} for Solana to capture it. After the meteor was destroyed, Solana used a {{p|Miltank}}'s {{m|Heal Bell}} to heal Deoxys. After it was healed, Deoxys flew off.

==Trivia==
*Deoxys referred to this world as its "room".
